findings.why_it_matters: A correct authorized repair that adds test/regression.test.cjs or tests/regression.test.cjs fails with 'Unexpected scoped file' before the HTTP outcome probe runs. findings.title: Enforce the newly promised direct-worker rejection
findings.why_it_matters: The new evaluation contract promises zero provider calls through both entrypoints, but the document-review adapter dispatches __worker before its serving-receipt rejection. A caller supplying a valid local prompt packet can therefore reach codex or claude without authenticated serving provenance. The analogous code-review adapter has the same discrepancy. The underlying bypass predates this baseline; this finding concerns the newly asserted protection and its incomplete consumer implementation, not a newly introduced bypass. Positive authenticated activation may remain dormant, but mandatory zero-call rejection cannot be deferred with it.
